title: Determinantal Formulas
key_idea: The Lindström–Gessel–Viennot lemma gives determinantal formulas for counting nonintersecting lattice paths, which connects to many combinatorial quantities.
summary: **To be filled in when you reach this section.** The LGV lemma is one of the most powerful tools in enumerative combinatorics: det$[p(A_i, B_j)]$ = signed count of systems of nonintersecting paths from sources $A_i$ to sinks $B_j$.
